author: BattleLab contributors

files.flows/triage.toml:
format = 1
title = "Triage"

[[steps]]
id = "read"
title = "Read the new messages"
brief = "Read everything new in {{inbox_name}}."
actor = { kind = "agent", engine = "claude" }

[[steps.checklist]]
key = "read_all"
title = "Every new message has been read and summarised"
probe = "supervisor_judged"

[[steps]]
id = "sort"
title = "Sort by urgency"
actor = { kind = "agent", engine = "codex" }
after = ["read"]

[[steps.checklist]]
key = "sorted"
title = "Each message is marked urgent or not, with a reason"
probe = "supervisor_judged"

[[steps.distinct_from]]
step = "read"
constraint = "engine"

[[steps]]
id = "confirm"
title = "Operator confirms"
actor = { kind = "operator" }
after = ["sort"]

[[steps.checklist]]
key = "confirmed"
title = "The operator agreed with the sorting"
probe = "supervisor_judged"
files.playbook.toml:
# A non-development playbook (#1096 §8): no connections, supervisor-judged checklists only.
format = 1
connections = []

[identity]
id = "inbox-triage"
name = "Inbox triage"
publisher = "Example"
version = "0.1.0"
domain = "mail"
summary = "Read an inbox, sort what needs an answer, and have the operator confirm."

[[variables]]
name = "inbox_name"
label = "Inbox"
required = true

[[variables]]
name = "urgency"
type = "enum"
label = "What counts as urgent"
choices = ["today", "this-week"]
default = "today"

[[materials]]
path = "docs/triage-rules.md"
disposition = "seed"
template = true

[flows]
default = "triage"
files.template/docs/triage-rules.md:
# Triage rules for {{inbox_name}}

Urgent means: needs an answer {{urgency}}.

summary: Read an inbox, sort what needs an answer, and have the operator confirm.
title: Inbox triage
